title: Diagonal Gaussian stability identity
statement: For all real numbers $\rho$ and $\alpha$, the Gaussian bivariate stability at $(\rho,\alpha,\alpha)$ equals the Gaussian halfspace stability at $(\rho,\alpha)$, with both quantities defined using the standard Gaussian measure and distribution function.
